narrative_and_purpose.mainPurpose: The video uses a high-energy interview format to reveal the lighter, often hidden side of doctors' professional lives, touching on topics like salary, long work hours, and department stereotypes. By combining humorous editing, rapid-fire Q&A, and relatable professional anecdotes, it aims to humanize the medical profession and engage the audience with comedic 'behind-the-scenes' content.
